name: Web Feature Squad
description: 범용 웹 기능을 구현하고 실제 브라우저 QA와 적대적 코드 리뷰를 병렬로 돌릴 때. 기본: 프론트엔드 개발(implement), Web QA(browser-qa), 코드 리뷰어(deep-review). 선택: 디자이너(ux-ideate), 상위 조언자(plan).

roles.title: Frontend Developer
checkpoints: Run the project's typecheck and focused unit tests.
roles.instructions: Implement the assigned feature within the ownership scope. Send the browser test entry point and diff to web-qa and reviewer.

roles.title: Web QA
checkpoints: Verify the critical user journey and relevant viewport and gesture cases.
roles.instructions: Discover live URLs with hc-team servers --run, then verify behavior in the browser. Report concise repro steps and artifact locations.

roles.title: Code Reviewer
checkpoints: Cite file and line evidence for each material finding.
roles.instructions: Review the diff independently for regressions, contract violations, and missing tests. Do not edit files. Send actionable findings to the author.

roles.title: Product Designer
checkpoints: Describe the intended hierarchy, interaction states, and responsive behavior.
roles.instructions: Specify the UI behavior and edge states for the feature. Share reviewable notes with dev and web-qa.

roles.title: Plan & Architecture Advisor
checkpoints: State boundaries, tradeoffs, and verification criteria are clear before implementation.
Scope creep and unnecessary abstractions are called out early.
roles.instructions: Advise on architecture, implementation plan, state ownership, and tradeoffs for complex web features without editing files. Share crisp plan guidance with dev, designer, and parent via hc-team send.
